exposure.needed: whether bugtool is invoked with --k8s-mode, --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace or --k8s-label in scripts or tooling

original.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and related --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

decision.reason: [ev-a7d9e5f931b3] lists these flags under "Bugtool Options" and says to use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump instead. That makes them options for running the bugtool tool by hand, not container arguments of Cilium's workloads. A cli-flag leaf would therefore not detect them, and no static input shows whether scripts or tooling still pass them. The proposed undecidable exposure (environment-visibility-gap) states exactly what is missing and does not invent a predicate.
